headline: Bitcoin Bounces Back
summary: Bitcoin fell to about $73,700 late on November 9, its lowest since August, in a slide that liquidated more than $1 billion in leveraged positions. It rebounded above $75,000 and was trading near $74,500 on the morning of November 10, holding above its 200-day moving average near $73,150, even as spot ETFs recorded $411.9 million in outflows on November 6 and $1.28 billion for the week.

headline: Huang Under Fire
summary: Nvidia shares fell more than 4% on Monday as the board's independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang continued. President Donald Trump said he spoke with Huang on Monday, with Huang denying any knowledge that Alice Huang was a spy; a shareholder class action has been filed, and three House committee chairs have requested a closed-door briefing on November 18. The board says it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised.

headline: CPI Day Arrives
summary: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics releases October CPI today, Tuesday, November 10, at 8:30 a.m. ET, the final inflation reading before the Federal Reserve's December meeting. Consensus expects headline CPI up 0.3% month over month and core CPI up 0.2%, cooling from September's 0.6% and 0.3%. This release will carry no year-over-year figures, because October 2025 price data was never collected during the government shutdown.

headline: COP31 Powers On
summary: COP31 enters its second day in Antalya, Türkiye, with today's theme focused on energy and transport. Brazilian President Lula arrives today ahead of the World Leaders Summit on November 11-12. Hosts Türkiye and Australia aim to raise electricity's share of global energy consumption to 35% by 2035, and the talks run until November 20.

headline: Depp Is Scrooge
summary: Johnny Depp walked the red carpet at the global premiere of Ebenezer in London's Leicester Square on Monday night, alongside director Ti West and co-stars including Rupert Grint. Depp plays Ebenezer Scrooge in the gothic-tinged Dickens remake, billed as his comeback after his high-profile legal battles. The film opens in cinemas on November 13.
